# OPEX PageBundle fixture

`tests/fixtures/page-bundle-opex.json` and `cypress/fixtures/narratives/opex-page.json` are identical, hand-written synthetic PageBundle v2 fixtures for identity `opex/global/en/default`. They are not Narrative Engine serializer output. The structure follows the Resource Mobilization and Access to Funding fixtures and the client parser rules in `src/app/types/narratives.ts`: eight sections in presentation order (budget position, efficiency, vs disbursement, actual vs budget, cost breakdown, key costs, indexed trends, cost table), a summary whose evidence is a subset of its contributing sections, and one calculation citation.

Source values are plausible figures taken from the public OPEX data (2025 total operating costs US$346.0 million actual against a US$346.0 million budget, 2026 budget and forecast US$310.3 million, pledge efficiency 7.28%, 6.50% and 6.44% for the three cycles, 8.9 cents per US$1 disbursed in 2025). Content hashes, metadata and prose are synthetic. The fixtures test contract, loading and rendering behavior and do not establish editorial quality. Replace them with an actual serializer capture once the engine produces one.
